name: com.threnjen.visual-verification
description: Deterministic PlayMode screenshot capture for visual acceptance testing. Loads a scene, steps a fixed number of frames under a fixed delta time, and writes PNGs plus a manifest so a reviewer (human or agent) can verify on-screen acceptance criteria. Engine-side capture only; judgement lives outside the package.

samples.description: A ready-to-edit capture-config.json. Import it, then move it to Assets/VisualVerification/capture-config.json and set your scene name.
